pr_title: Ensure multiple executions of a restart automation in the same event loop iteration are allowed
pr_body:
## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->

Remove the sleep since it the restart executions end up in a race and all get cancelled. The downside is it makes it harder to break infinite loops, but we do allow automations to restart themselves so there isn't a way to fully prevent someone from making an infinite loop.

fixes #119097 fixes #118638

issue_context.title: Automation in restart mode - All runs cancelled
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When an automation in the `restart` mode is triggered 3 times or more at a time, all the automation runs are cancelled.

I am attaching an example code for the demonstration. When the `test_input_boolean` state is changed, one persistent notification should be displayed. In reality, however, no notification is displayed. According to the automation traces, all 3 automation runs are cancelled.

(I'm sorry that the screenshots are in Czech. But I think it's understandable anyway.)

![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/1684619/361ef9be-6690-43f9-9766-1c991db569ae)

![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/1684619/89d53b71-eecd-4dd2-b62b-28447125af23)

![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/1684619/891beeaf-f2d5-4c0b-bfec-a266f88f033f)

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2024.5.5

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

automation

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/docs/automation/yaml/#automation-modes

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
input_boolean:
  test_input_boolean:
    name: "Test - Input Boolean"

template:
  - binary_sensor:
      - name: "Test - Binary Sensor 1"
        unique_id: test_binary_sensor_1
        state: "{{ is_state('input_boolean.test_input_boolean', 'on')}}"
  - binary_sensor:
      - name: "Test - Binary Sensor 2"
        unique_id: test_binary_sensor_2
        state: "{{ is_state('input_boolean.test_input_boolean', 'on')}}"
  - binary_sensor:
      - name: "Test - Binary Sensor 3"
        unique_id: test_binary_sensor_3
        state: "{{ is_state('input_boolean.test_input_boolean', 'on')}}"

automation:
  - alias: "Test - Automation"
    trigger:
      - platform: state
        entity_id:
          - binary_sensor.test_binary_sensor_1
          - binary_sensor.test_binary_sensor_2
          - binary_sensor.test_binary_sensor_3
    action:
      - delay:
          seconds: 1
      - service: notify.persistent_notification
        data:
          message: "Test Automation"
    mode: restart
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
Nothing displayed in the logs in the UI.
```


### Additional information

_No response_

I think I've actually seen similar behavior with `restart` automations in 2024.5.x and 2024.6.x.

I can also confirm the issue with an input boolean and this automation:

```yaml
alias: Test Restart Automation
description: ""
trigger:
  - platform: state
    entity_id:
      - input_boolean.test_input_boolean
    to: "on"
  - platform: state
    entity_id:
      - input_boolean.test_input_boolean
    to: "on"
  - platform: state
    entity_id:
      - input_boolean.test_input_boolean
    to: "on"
condition: []
action:
  - delay:
      hours: 0
      minutes: 0
      seconds: 1
      milliseconds: 0
  - service: notify.julian_telegram
    metadata: {}
    data:
      message: test
mode: restart
```


Depending on how long the service takes to execute, the `delay` might not even be needed(?)
But with it, I can reproduce the issue 100%. Currently running core `2024.6.0`.

I've definitely also seen this in some actual (light-related) automations that have the `restart` mode.

@bdraco You already had fixed some similar issues where script/automations cancelled in `restart` mode in previous releases. Are you aware of any other issues with this? (or have some time to also take a look at this? 😄 )

I also see this issue with a real automation for my window blind. The automation is quite complex and I can see it almost every day. The example YAML I have included is just for the demonstration, but the issue can easily occur even in a real case of use.
I have fixed a few ones recently, but this looks different. Is there a minimal reliable reproducer available?

Yeah, see the automation I have in [my comment above](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/118638#issuecomment-2150734310). That's as minimal I was able to get it with reproducing consistently.
You just need to create an input boolean and test that automation. 
Oh, and might wanna change the service at the end (send a notification in my example—it can do anything, doesn't really matter, as the automation doesn't get to that point when looking at the traces).

There's also one automation in the initial post.

@TheJulianJES @LucasCZE 
Can you confirmed the linked PR https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/119100 fixes this problem?

Did a quick test with the example I had in [my comment above](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/118638#issuecomment-2150734310) and the issue seems to be fixed then.
And as always, thanks for your work!

From the automation traces, the first automation run got into the delay and was restarted then:
![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/6409465/bee6d6a4-1eb4-4c1f-bbf4-4d83e26699e4)

The second run was restarted before it even got to the delay:
![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/6409465/d0a22e75-46b5-4ba6-aca5-beefde76ac82)

And as expected, with the fix, the last run completed now:
![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/6409465/f981a868-89d8-4b84-8eb1-b600e93132ed)

That's just an observation, the fixed behavior seems fine to me.
Thanks for the fix @bdraco and thanks for testing it @TheJulianJES. I really don't know how to test the fix. But as per the comment above, I believe the bug is fixed. Thank you again. :thumbsup:
Just FYI, I updated my HA to 2024.6.3 (the fix was included in 2024.6.2) and the issue is fixed also in my environment. :thumbsup:

review_comments: I'm not sure this is a good thing, but we seem to explicitly want to allow infinite loops with restart automations are they are allowed to restart themselves
I'm not sure this is a good thing, but we seem to explicitly want to allow infinite loops with restart automations are they are allowed to restart themselves

If there is no delay here, the infinite loop will never yield so it will never finish otherwise. This is apparently intended to be allowed as restart mode automations are allowed to restart themselves
